objective: Formalize iff_s as the typed statistical projection operator that maps lawful process structures into probability/statistical observables without collapsing projection into process identity.
governance_note: This patch closes language-level statistical projection scaffolds only. It does not certify physics correspondence, convert raw simulation frequency into governed probability, or promote bridge claims.

formal_definition.title: Formal Principle 7.X: Statistical Projection Operator
formal_definition.core_definition: The operator \iff_s is the typed projection relation by which lawful process structures are represented as statistical observables under declared admissibility and normalization conditions.
formal_skeleton: X \iff_s P_X is defined iff Type(X) is declared and ProjectionMap_s(X) is declared.
X must be an RT, aRT, typed composition structure, metric projection, asymmetry ratio, or admissibility distribution candidate.
P_X must be marked as statistical_projection_app.
Norm(P_X) must be one of: normalized, conditionally_normalized, comparative_weight.
P_X = P_Y does not imply X = Y.
X = Y may imply compatible P_X and P_Y only under a declared projection map.
failure_conditions: FAIL_IFF_S_001: missing or invalid operand typing
FAIL_IFF_S_005: projection equivalence mistaken for process identity
FAIL_IFF_S_006: raw simulation frequency treated as governed probability
FAIL_IFF_S_007: probability assigned outside declared admissibility window
formal_definition.anti_reification_note: iff_s does not create probability as a primitive substance. It marks a projection layer from lawful process structure into statistical observable form.

appendix_f_update.note: iff_s no longer listed as incomplete missing formalism after typed statistical projection rules, normalization requirements, and failure conditions are added.

forbidden_promotions: claiming statistical equivalence proves process identity
treating raw simulation frequency as governed probability
